text: tujhe purane conversation se kuch yaad hai kya

Main ek AI assistant hoon, Copilot SDK ka use karke VS Code me available hoon.

Purane conversation ka exact memory generally is nahi hota, unless specific session history ya project context explicitly available ho. Is current chat me jo workspace aur context diya gaya hai, usse thoda sa yaad hai — jaise ki repo ka naam aur kuch project files — lekin previous separate chat threads ya personal conversation ka pura record mujhe usually nahi milta.

Agar aap chaho, to main yeh quickly summarize kar sakta hoon:
- current workspace kya hai
- main project ke baare me kya samajh raha hoon
- aur aapne jo bhi specific ask kiya hai, us par directly kaam kar sakta hoon

Agar aapko yaad hai koi specific past discussion, to usko phir se brief karke bata do — main usko fresh se handle kar dunga.
